text_en: This is the reason that I Paul am a prisoner for Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles—
text_cn: 因此，我保禄为你们外邦人的缘故，作基督耶稣囚犯的，为你们祈祷──

text_en: for surely you have already heard of the commission of God’s grace that was given me for you,
text_cn: 想你们必听说过天主的恩宠，为了你们赐与我的职分：

text_en: and how the mystery was made known to me by revelation, as I wrote above in a few words,
text_cn: 就是藉着启示，使我得知我在上边已大略写过的奥秘；

text_en: a reading of which will enable you to perceive my understanding of the mystery of Christ.
text_cn: 你们照着读了，便能明白我对基督的奥秘所有的了解，

text_en: In former generations this mystery was not made known to humankind, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit:
text_cn: 这奥秘在以前的世代中，没有告诉过任何人，有如现在一样，藉圣神已启示给他的圣宗徒和先知；

text_en: that is, the Gentiles have become fellow heirs, members of the same body, and sharers in the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel.
text_cn: 这奥秘就是：外邦人藉着福音在基督耶稣内与犹太人同为承继人，同为一身，同为恩许的分享人。

text_en: Of this gospel I have become a servant according to the gift of God’s grace that was given me by the working of his power.
text_cn: 至于我，我依照天主大能的功效所赐与我的恩宠，作了这福音的仆役；

text_en: Although I am the very least of all the saints, this grace was given to me to bring to the Gentiles the news of the boundless riches of Christ,
text_cn: 我原是一切圣徒中最小的，竟蒙受了这恩宠，得向外邦宣布基督那不可测量的丰富福音，

text_en: and to make everyone see what is the plan of the mystery hidden for ages in God who created all things;
text_cn: 并光照一切人，使他们明白，从创世以来，即隐藏在创造万有的天主内的奥秘，

text_en: so that through the church the wisdom of God in its rich variety might now be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly places.
text_cn: 为使天上的率领者和掌权者，现在藉着教会，得知天主的各样智慧，

text_en: This was in accordance with the eternal purpose that he has carried out in Christ Jesus our Lord,
text_cn: 全是按照他在我们的主基督耶稣内所实现的永远计划；

text_en: in whom we have access to God in boldness and confidence through faith in him.
text_cn: 所以只有在基督内，我们才可藉着对他所怀的信德，放心大胆地怀着依恃之心，进到天主面前。

text_en: I pray therefore that you may not lose heart over my sufferings for you; they are your glory.
text_cn: 为此，我请求你们，不要因我为你们所受的苦难而沮丧，我的苦难原是你们的光荣。

text_en: For this reason I bow my knees before the Father,
text_cn: 因此，我在天父面前屈膝──

text_en: from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.
text_cn: 上天下地的一切家族都是由他而得名 ──

text_en: I pray that, according to the riches of his glory, he may grant that you may be strengthened in your inner being with power through his Spirit,
text_cn: 求他依照他丰富的光荣，藉着他的圣神，以大能坚固你们内在的人，

text_en: and that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, as you are being rooted and grounded in love.
text_cn: 并使基督因着你们的信德，住在你们心中，叫你们在爱德上根深蒂固，奠定基础，

text_en: I pray that you may have the power to comprehend, with all the saints, what is the breadth and length and height and depth,
text_cn: 为使你们能够同众圣徒领悟基督的爱是怎样的广、宽、高、深，

text_en: and to know the love of Christ that surpasses knowledge, so that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
text_cn: 并知道基督的爱是远超人所能知的，为叫你们充满天主的一切富裕。

text_en: Now to him who by the power at work within us is able to accomplish abundantly far more than all we can ask or imagine,
text_cn: 愿光荣归于天主，他能照他在我们身上所发挥的德能，成就一切，远超我们所求所想的。

text_en: to him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
text_cn: 愿他在教会内并在基督耶稣内，获享光荣，至于万世万代！阿们。
